plugins.name: AI Background Removal
plugins.description: Remove the background from a saved image with U2-Net-P, entirely offline once the 4.5 MB model is downloaded. A preview must be accepted before anything is saved.
plugins.author: Pigeon
plugins.source: U2-Net (Qin et al.) as distributed by rembg
plugins.privacy: Setup downloads the Python packages and model files once. Images and prompts are processed locally and never sent anywhere.

plugins.name: AI Image Enlarger
plugins.description: Offline 3x image enlargement with a sub-pixel convolutional neural network. The model is tiny (235 KB) and ships inside the plugin; only Python packages are installed once, at setup.
plugins.author: Pigeon
plugins.privacy: Runs entirely on this computer. Images are never sent anywhere. Setup installs Python packages from PyPI once.

plugins.name: AI Image Expand
plugins.description: Enlarge the canvas and the model paints in the new border (outpainting). Uses MI-GAN, a 28 MB inpainting model, so it is fast on CPU. Your original pixels are never altered. The result must be accepted before it is saved as a derivative.
plugins.author: Pigeon
plugins.source: MI-GAN (Picsart AI Research, ICCV 2023), ONNX pipeline export
plugins.privacy: Setup downloads the Python packages and model files once. Images and prompts are processed locally and never sent anywhere.

plugins.name: AI Image Expand (Diffusion)
plugins.description: Enlarge the canvas by any amount and Stable Diffusion 1.5 Inpainting paints in the new border at full resolution, continuing the scene. About 2.1 GB of models, runs offline on CPU and is slow (minutes to hours for large images). Your original pixels are never altered. The result must be accepted before it is saved as a derivative.
plugins.author: Pigeon
plugins.source: Stable Diffusion 1.5 Inpainting (RunwayML / Stability AI), fp16 ONNX conversion by RanaLLC; the safety checker is intentionally not included
plugins.privacy: Setup downloads the Python packages and model files once. Images and prompts are processed locally and never sent anywhere.

plugins.name: AI Object Removal
plugins.description: Paint over an object and LaMa inpaints the background. Runs offline once the 198 MB model is downloaded. The result must be accepted before it is saved as a derivative.
plugins.author: Pigeon
plugins.source: LaMa (Suvorov et al.), ONNX export by Carve
plugins.privacy: Setup downloads the Python packages and model files once. Images and prompts are processed locally and never sent anywhere.

plugins.name: Immich
plugins.description: Browse an Immich server's photos in Pigeon (Immich / Annual / year / month), see server thumbnails, send local files to Immich and download originals into a local folder with checksum and metadata verification. Runs in its own process; uninstalling it removes its cache, catalogue and keychain entries.
plugins.author: Pigeon
plugins.source: Immich server HTTP API (https://immich.app); reqwest, rusqlite (bundled), image
network: the Immich server you configure (HTTPS recommended; HTTP exposes traffic to the local network)
plugins.privacy: Talks only to the Immich server you configure. Passwords are kept in the system keychain (or in memory for a session-only login) and never written to disk. Thumbnails and the catalogue are cached in this plugin's private data folder and removed by uninstalling it. Originals are downloaded only when you explicitly transfer them.

plugins.name: Reelio
plugins.description: Local media container editor: import video, audio and subtitles, edit tracks, trims, chapters, metadata, covers and subtitles, then export to a new MP4, M4V or MKV with verified output. Sources are never changed.
plugins.author: Chris Visser

plugins.name: Local Semantic Search
plugins.description: Private multimodal similarity search, knowledge-graph clustering and tag suggestions using EmbeddingGemma 2 (768-dim embeddings of text, images and video), computed on this computer. Setup downloads about 1.5 GB once. The plugin runs its indexing engine locally.
plugins.author: Pigeon
plugins.privacy: Setup downloads the Python packages and the model once. Your files and queries stay on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere. Not a generative chatbot.
plugins.source: google/embeddinggemma-2 on Hugging Face (Apache-2.0), pinned to a commit
